subcategory_text: Systems/products/services and associated data are formally managed throughout removal, transfers, and disposition.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: MP-6 (Media Sanitization), SR-12 (Component Disposal), CM-3 (Configuration Change Control)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.10 (Information deletion), A.8.11 (Data masking)
implementation_examples: Formally manage personal-data systems through removal, transfers, and disposition, with documented procedures and approval gates
Capture chain of custody during transfers and disposition
assessment_objectives: Determine whether removal, transfers, and disposition are formally managed
Determine whether procedures cover hardware, software, and data assets
Determine whether chain-of-custody evidence is captured
Determine whether third-party assets are covered
